title: The trace of a constructible set on a constructible set is constructible there
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space which has a basis of the topology consisting of quasi-compact open subsets. Let $E,E'\subseteq X$ be constructible subsets of $X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Then $E\cap E'$ is a constructible subset of the topological space $E$ (with the subspace topology) [def-weil-constructible-subset] (Stacks Topology, Lemma 09YI).

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 09YI (Lemma 5.15.11, lemma-intersect-constructible-with-constructible, line 2750; its proof combines Lemmas 09YF and 09YH)
